summary: Keep committed BTC state queryable during normal forward block execution
details: RPC and economic derivation use independent SQLite readers and height-bounded energy history. The head identity advances with each committed block instead of waiting for the entire sync batch.

Readiness adds committed_query_ready. Mining checks accept BlockProcessingPending only when the indexer explicitly reports safe committed reads; failed attempts, recovery, shutdown and identity mismatches remain blocking.

State queries hold a shared recovery barrier through derivation. Reorg and failed publication recovery wait for active reads; new reads fail promptly while recovery is queued or running. Normal forward indexing continues concurrently.
Publication transitions can still require retries. This does not add Go deferred validation or miner gap policy and does not change network identity, database format or economic rules.
